fact: ANSICE held a meeting on 2 July 2025 on adopting an advanced PKI infrastructure and qualified e-signature for public services with the vendor Xayone, discussing PKI modules, e-signature and key protection.
title: ANSICE & XAYONE : Un pas de plus vers la confiance numérique !
publisher: Agence Nationale de Sécurité Informatique et de Certification Electronique (ANSICE)-TCHAD
